name: hnx_rp4a4_pvm-g1-COMMIT
purpose: HBM-NEXT-ATT4 (next-release HBM die, P = 4; NOT a release element): per-lane PV merge master of the P = 4 attention leaf hnx_rp4a4 -- ot_hnx_att_pv_merge (verbatim fork of the release ot_hbm_sm_pv_merge, PUBLISH = 1) on its own 64x512 stack macro, every pin registered; hardened once, replicated 4x per BF16 column beside the 4-lane tcl of hnx_rp4lp4.
